decision.summary: A multi-sample triaxial offset initiates near index 629–630 (N↓, E↓, U↑), persists through 637, and shows only partial, non-opposing recovery in U by 638; N and E remain offset at end of allowed context. Return is unobserved/ambiguous, so status is uncertain. The earlier region near 545 lies outside allowed_context [590,670] and is excluded.

intervals.observation: Triaxial shift onset at ~629–630: N drops ~2 MAD, E drops ~1.5 MAD, U rises ~1.5 MAD; interior (631–637) shows sustained offset with noisy fluctuations but no return to pre-event level; recovery ambiguous—U begins descending after 637 but N/E remain depressed through 638 (last index in allowed context). No opposing return observed within allowed_context.
